title: Macro-Conditioned Order Flow Absorption & Terminal Microstructure Reversion on BTC/USDT

inSamplePartition.purpose: Exploratory calibration and microstructural rule discovery

outOfSamplePartition.purpose: Strict blind replay and Wilson CI gate

rules.CALL: Close(t-1) >= SMA1440(t-1) * (1 - 0.015) (Macro Ok) AND Range_t >= 1.5 * ATR_14(t-1) AND Close_t < Open_t (BEAR M1) AND LowTiming < 50s AND Last5sWick >= 0.35 AND Close_5s > Open_5s (Pro-Fade) AND (DeltaV_5s >= 0 OR TakerSellShare_5s <= 0.45)
rules.PUT: Close(t-1) <= SMA1440(t-1) * (1 + 0.015) (Macro Ok) AND Range_t >= 1.5 * ATR_14(t-1) AND Close_t > Open_t (BULL M1) AND HighTiming < 50s AND Last5sWick >= 0.35 AND Close_5s < Open_5s (Pro-Fade) AND (DeltaV_5s <= 0 OR TakerBuyShare_5s <= 0.45)
rules.NO_SIGNAL: Macro trend conflict, Range < 1.5 * ATR, Lack of 5s wick, Counter-fade 5s close, Late extreme (>= 50s), Unabsorbed aggression, or Lookback < 1440
